selection: Jan-May log return minus half absolute MDD; training MDD <=-50% excluded; top1% training eligible, June-July objective winner; no August-September selection
regime: QQQ USD prior 20 actual US sessions, +/-3% plus MA20 confirmation; first21 unknown
price_basis: Split-adjusted Close in KRW; dividends and taxes excluded; daily FX marks
disclosure_rule: Latest snapshot as_of STRICTLY BEFORE local execution calendar date
execution: Same-US-close fractional fills after earning existing holdings return; latest disclosure strictly before execution date; no leverage, KRW cash zero interest

fees.includes: assumed commission + slippage + currency exchange allowance
fees.terminal: mark to market, no forced sale fee

first_entry: All accounts begin cash; first disclosure-following date benchmark entry; strategy waits in cash until its first eligible signal; subsequent rebalances calendar-based
targets: Strategy cumulative percentage return >=2x or3x EACH ETF cumulative percentage return; ratios defined only for positive ETF returns. This is not multiplying ending wealth.
limitations: US-only adaptive additional exploration after viewing original global research results. The historical August-September holdout is reused, not independent validation. Candidate selection remains January-May training and June-July validation only.

The source snapshots were retrieved retrospectively, mainly 2026-09-27. as_of_date is a disclosure label, not an archived publication timestamp. Execution must impose a disclosure delay; historical point-in-time availability is not proven.
Maximum holdings is a cap; fewer eligible names can cause concentration.
20-session price features and +1-session delay now refer to US sessions; flows remain KRX sessions.
Split-adjusted close fills, fractional positions and daily FX are assumptions; taxes/dividends excluded.
ETF benchmarks use US-date marks; this maximum drawdown samples that same date axis.
There is no guarantee of future 2x/3x ETF returns or exact executable order returns.
research_status: US-only adaptive additional exploration after viewing original global research results. The historical August-September holdout is reused, not independent validation. Candidate selection remains January-May training and June-July validation only.
experiment: US-listed securities only; maximum ten; actual US session calendar
calendar: actual observed QQQ Close dates within original sample only
flow_policy: 1/3/5/10/20/40 KRX sessions; original full-fund CU/common factors; no recomputation on US subset
nav_weight_policy: original NAV weights retained, not renormalized after US filtering
order_access: User confirmed orders can be submitted; no further access approval needed
order_return_limitation: Historical assumed fills do not guarantee actual order or account returns
